reflection:
First session, a partial day: entries at about 14:15 New York time, close at 16:00.
- **Difference from the control:** the LLM review vetoed LLY and MRK (results Thu 29 Oct) and AAPL (results Mon 2 Nov),
  shrank MET (results 4 Nov) and bought KO (beat and raised guidance on 27 Oct), which the control did not hold.
  The control held LLY and AAPL instead of KO.
- **Result:** both accounts were flat into the close (main +0.01%, control -0.01%) while the S&P 500 gained about 0.19%
  from the entry time. That is too small a difference to mean anything.
- **Vetoes:** no outcomes yet. LLY and MRK report before tomorrow's open, so the 1-day outcome of the earnings vetoes
  is known at tomorrow's close. This is the first real test of the "no entry before earnings" rule.
- **No stop-outs**, and no calls have elapsed outcome windows yet.
- **Process note:** in earnings season, 3 of the 8 top S&P 100 momentum names had results within 3 trading days.
  The earnings check is the most important part of the US review right now.
- **No lessons added:** no evidence yet. Candidate to watch: whether vetoing names into earnings beats holding them.

First day of the Rs 1 lakh desk (restarted 30 Oct; the Rs 10 lakh run is archived). Entries at about 11:10 IST.
- **Close:** LLM-reviewed Rs 99,821 (-0.18%), LLM off Rs 99,897 (-0.10%), Nifty 50 22,943 -> 23,027 on the day (+0.37%).
  Both books are about a quarter invested (bear regime halves new buys; one share of HAL or TVSMOTOR already uses the
  Rs 5,000 half-slot), so most of the gap to the index is cash.
- **Difference from the control:** the review vetoed NYKAA and ZYDUSLIFE (results Wed 4 Nov). The control bought both:
  ZYDUSLIFE closed +5.0% on the day after the entry around 1,231, NYKAA about flat. That is the whole 0.08 pp gap.
- **Analyst calls from 28 Oct, 1-day outcomes:** the LAURUSLABS Underweight (results day) was wrong so far: the stock
  beat (H1 EBITDA margin 33.2%, Galenvs acquisition) and is +5.7% vs the index after one day, +6.1% again today.
  FEDERALBNK (Buy) -2.8% and ADANIPORTS (Hold) -2.2% vs the index.
- **Pattern to watch (not yet a lesson, 1-day outcomes are noise):** vetoes placed only because results were due have
  now cost money twice on strong momentum names that then beat: LLY (US, 29 Oct, about +4%) and LAURUSLABS (India).
  Check the 5-day outcomes on 4-5 Nov before writing a lesson; the counter-case would be a vetoed name that falls on
  its results (NYKAA and ZYDUSLIFE report on 4 Nov).
- **Stops:** none hit; every position is 10-13% above its stop.

First India session (entries 09:36 IST, review at 15:05 IST; the Accounts table above was taken at midday).
- **Close:** LLM-reviewed Rs 10,03,674 (+0.37%), LLM off Rs 10,04,898 (+0.49%), Nifty 50 +1.07% (22,698.85 to ~22,943).
  LLM edge -0.12 pp. Both books trailed the index mainly because both held about 61-68% cash: bear regime (Nifty
  below its 200-DMA) halves new buys, so the books are only a third invested.
- **Difference from the control:** the review vetoed LAURUSLABS and softened five Buys to Overweight (Hold ratings on
  ADANIPORTS, DIVISLAB, ZYDUSLIFE, NYKAA, ETERNAL), so the reviewed book held fewer shares of each (e.g. ADANIPORTS 20
  vs 27, ETERNAL 115 vs 153). It was a broad up day (ADANIPORTS +5.9%, ETERNAL +3.6% on the day), so the smaller
  sizes cost about 0.12 pp. That is one day of a rising market, not evidence about the Hold rule.
- **Veto outcome so far:** LAURUSLABS (results day, board meeting 29 Oct) +1.8% vs Nifty +1.1% by 15:05, excess about
  +0.7%: the veto cost a little on day 1. The 5-day excess in the vetoes table is the real test, as the results
  reaction plays out.
- **Stops:** none hit; every position is 9-13% above its stop.
- **Lessons:** none added (one day). Candidate to watch: whether entry-day Hold size cuts on stocks with results 4-7
  trading days away (NYKAA, ZYDUSLIFE) pay off once those results land on 4 Nov.
